candidate_evidence.quote: Quisinostat: a highly potent and orally active HDAC inhibitor

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly-diagnosed and Recurrent Grade 4 IDH-Wildtype Glioblastomas

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Total and unbound quisinostat concentration will be quantified in Gd-enhancing and Gd-non-enhancing tumor tissue collected during Phase 0 surgery.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Tumor tissue collected during surgery will be compared to baseline tissue to assess fold induction change of AcH3K9/14, pH2AX, ClCas-3, and MIB-1.

role_evidence.quote: Participants with tumors demonstrating PK response will continue with therapeutic dosing of quisinostat treatment on Monday, Wednesday, Friday of 5-day cycles after surgery concurrently with their standard of care (SOC) fractionated RT.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: a highly potent and orally active HDAC inhibitor

role_evidence.quote: Participants must be willing to receive prophylaxis with levetiracetam for the duration of study drug administration (or alternative anti-epileptic if agreed with Medical Monitor).

source_quote.quote: Participants who have had a prior resection of diagnosed glioblastoma, IDH wildtype (2021 WHO grade 4)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: AcH3K9/14, pH2AX, ClCas-3, MIB-1 (tumour pharmacodynamic markers)

source_quote.quote: Tumor tissue collected during surgery will be compared to baseline tissue to assess fold induction change of AcH3K9/14, pH2AX, ClCas-3, and MIB-1.

coder_notes: Phase 0/1b (EARLY_PHASE1). Regimen is combination because the expansion phase gives quisinostat with standard fractionated radiotherapy; Phase 0 is quisinostat alone before resection. Levetiracetam prophylaxis is required of participants in the eligibility text but is not a registered intervention. PD marker row is not an eligibility/enrichment biomarker, so does not affect candidate_matched_selection.
